content.short: Instarem is Nium's cross-border remittance brand for low-cost international transfers and a multi-currency card.
content.description: Instarem, launched in 2014 and now the consumer remittance brand of the global payments company Nium, lets individuals and businesses send money across borders at competitive rates. From its app it offers international transfers to more than 60 countries, an InstaPoints rewards program, and the amaze multi-currency card for spending abroad, all backed by Nium's licensed payments infrastructure across Asia-Pacific, Europe and North America. Instarem targets migrants, families, freelancers and SMEs who need reliable, low-cost remittances and foreign exchange without the markups of traditional banks. It pairs a consumer-friendly app with enterprise-grade payment rails.
